content.title: SUNS at SPURS | FULL GAME HIGHLIGHTS | March 19, 2026
content.text: 609,793 views • Mar 19, 2026 The Spurs defeated the Suns, 101-100 tonight in San Antonio. Victor Wembanyama finished with a team-high 34 points along with 12 rebounds and 3 steals for the Spurs, while De'Aaron Fox tallied 23 points, 7 rebounds and 3 assists in the game. Collin Gillespie recorded 24 points, 6 assists and 6 three pointers.
